text:
rachel: alerting 8: small-but-impactful firewall tighten went through to eu-west; a chunk of GPU nodes are failing keystore decrypt during boot. saw KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied in the logs. anyone know what changed?
omar: yep seeing it. sample from node: "keystore: KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied proxy=10.2.14.3". warmpool join stalled, backlog growing.
kevin: quick check of the TF diff  someone narrowed keystore proxy egress to a hand-curated list of /28s and the AZ-b proxy fell outside that list. we accidentally removed the larger superset rule.
ops-oncall: opening P1 INC-6100. immediate mitigation: add a temp egress rule to allow gpu-subnets -> 10.2.0.0/16:443. need sign-off to touch SG.
rachel: emergency approved, do it now. revert via pipeline PR once stable.
omar: applied manual egress (CLI):
```bash
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-gpu-provision --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.2.0.0/16 --region eu-west-2
```
omar: warmpool starts rejoining, +7 nodes within 5m, backlog draining.
sre-bot: INC-6100 created (severity=P1) and paged ops-oncall.
audit-bot: detected missing keystore.decrypt events 2026-03-24T09:48:00 to 2026-03-24T10:02:00; filed SIEM-1400 for re-ingest.
kevin: pushed a firewall PR to restore a /16 superset and add explicit per-AZ allowlists + an e2e canary that curls /keystore/health via the proxy from a GPU image: https://git.internal/rw/firewall/pull/1042
ops-oncall: infra-ci blocked the next apply due to manual drift; recommend adding a TF preflight check that resolves proxy hostnames and verifies the CIDR is a superset (INFRA-512).
rachel: also note cost impact: autoscaler spun fallback nodes in us-east and we pulled ~600GB of model shards cross-region. rough egress delta ~+$900, add to RCA.
kevin: filing INFRA-512 and INFRA-513 (canary in rollout).
ops-oncall: INC-6100 -> mitigated after manual rule. keeping incident open until SIEM confirms backfill and PR merges.
sre-bot: INC-6100 resolved at 2026-03-24T10:05:00Z (monitoring stable).
rachel: follow-ups: review PR, merge preflight CI, SIEM backfill confirmation, update runbook to call out CIDR superset checks. thanks all. :thumbsup:
omar: will monitor SIEM-1400 and close INC-6100 once re-ingest done.
kevin: adding unit test to firewall repo to catch CIDR shrink in future.
